questions.question_text: You need to ensure that a specific Azure resource group cannot be accidentally deleted by administrators. Which feature should you use?
questions.explanation: Resource locks can be applied to prevent accidental deletion or modification of resources. The 'Delete' lock ensures that users cannot delete the resource group unless the lock is removed.

questions.question_text: Your company needs to ensure that all Azure resources are tagged with 'Environment: Production'. Which tool can enforce this policy?
questions.explanation: Azure Policy allows you to enforce organizational standards and assess compliance at-scale. You can create a policy definition to ensure all resources have the required tags.

questions.question_text: How can you ensure that certain users in your organization can only view the cost details of an Azure subscription without modifying any resources?

options.label: A
options.text: Assign them the 'Owner' role at the subscription level.

options.label: B
options.text: Assign them the 'Reader' role at the subscription level.

options.label: C
options.text: Assign them the 'Contributor' role at the resource group level.

options.label: D
options.text: Assign them the 'Cost Management Reader' role at the resource level.

questions.explanation: The 'Reader' role provides read-only access to Azure resources and allows users to view cost details without the ability to make changes.

questions.question_text: You want to manage multiple Azure subscriptions under a single organizational hierarchy. What should you configure?
questions.explanation: Management groups in Azure provide a way to manage access, policy, and compliance across multiple Azure subscriptions.

questions.question_text: Your organization wants to receive notifications when spending reaches 80% of the allocated budget for an Azure subscription. What should you configure?
questions.explanation: Azure Budgets allow you to set spending limits and receive alerts when spending reaches a specified percentage of the budget.

questions.question_text: You need to prevent all virtual machines in a resource group from being started or stopped. Which Azure feature should you use?
questions.explanation: A read-only lock can be applied to a resource group to prevent any changes, including starting or stopping virtual machines.
